hero.name: Jack Anderson Limas Solarte
hero.subtitle: I build software that solves real-world problems
hero.description: Software Engineering student, passionate about web development and digital solutions. Detail-oriented, a constant learner, able to turn ideas into functional projects.

about.description: 👋 I'm Jack Limas, 19 years old, from Pasto, Colombia. I'm curious, observant, and focused, calm knowing where I'm headed and with a clear purpose. I value my surroundings, from my family to loyal friends, 'Loyalty is a two-way street. If you ask for it, you'll get it from me.' In my free time I like to do a bit of everything or simply enjoy the moment. I enjoy mixing visuals and logic, and love solving and designing things, especially programming.
about.story: I chose Software Engineering because I've always been curious about how technology can change lives. Today I see it as a way to create, innovate and take ideas to another level. I always wondered how things worked, and now I see it as a way to build the future.

hobbies.description: Trap, rap, classics, and more; I love discovering new genres and always have a playlist for every moment. 🎵
I've been to many cities, each leaving a story and new way of seeing life. 🌎
Not just a fan—I play; on the court, I find discipline, passion and fun. ⚽
From VR to fintechs like Nequi, I’m drawn to what transforms how we live. 🚀
I don’t stick to one game; discovering and living each digital experience as if it were new. 🎮

offer.description: I'm passionate about technology and design. I'm known for my commitment in every project, finding practical, creative and functional solutions. I enjoy teamwork, adapting to challenges and bringing innovation to each stage of development. My goal is to deliver high-quality results that exceed expectations.
skills: HTML & CSS — for structure and style
JavaScript & TypeScript — for interactivity and dynamic solutions
Figma — interface design and rapid prototyping
GitHub — version control and collaborative work

projects.title: Automated Train Ticket System
projects.description: Academic project designing a system for automatic train ticket management. Includes class diagrams, user stories and architecture planning. Focused on principles of object-oriented design and software patterns.

projects.title: PC Gaming Configurator (Angular + TypeScript)
projects.description: Developed an interactive application allowing PC gamer configuration. Used Angular, TypeScript, CSS, HTML with the Decorator pattern for dynamic interfaces and modular architecture.

projects.title: Spotify Style Playlist (TypeScript)
projects.description: Desktop/web app in TypeScript with linked lists for playlist management. Inspired by Spotify UI, focusing on data structures and interface design.

experience.title: Final Project — Digital Orders
experience.description: Currently developing a digital order system for restaurants to optimize order management and improve customer experience. 📱

experience.title: University Volunteer
experience.description: Volunteered at my university, strengthening teamwork, communication and leadership skills while adding value to the environment. 🤝

experience.title: Seminars & Conferences
experience.description: Attended various technology seminars focused on development and trends, broadening my vision on innovation’s real-world impact. 🦾

experience.title: Scripts & Academic Projects
experience.description: Created scripts, programs and web pages, solidifying my programming skills, learning modern technologies, and building practical digital experiences. 💻

experience.title: Stylish Brands — Urban Fashion Store
experience.description: Created an urban fashion brand and e-commerce site, integrating design, programming and business management. 🛍️

testimonials.quote: Jack has incredible talent for programming and design. In group work, he always brings quick, practical solutions that move the team forward.
testimonials.author: Juan David Maya

testimonials.quote: What I value most about Jack is his dedication. You see his passion for what he does and it energizes the rest. Thanks to him, I learned to see programming simply.
testimonials.author: Juan Felpie Mora

testimonials.quote: Working with Jack is motivating. He brings lots of creative ideas and always aims to improve projects, plus he never hesitates to help others when they're stuck.
testimonials.author: Laura Martínez
